case_brief.subject: Ration Card (Public Distribution System)
case_brief.what_it_is: The Ration Card is an official document issued by state governments under the Public Distribution System (PDS) that allows beneficiaries to access foodgrains and essential commodities at subsidized rates through Fair Price Shops. It serves as a legal document for identification and entitlement to government food security programs.
case_brief.entitlement: The complainant is entitled to the issuance of a valid ration card upon successful application and verification, which allows them to draw public distribution commodities from a designated Fair Price Shop.
conditions: The applicant must not furnish false documents or certificates to obtain a ration card.
The applicant must not attempt to obtain a card through impersonation or fraudulent means.
The ration card holder must not be absent from their residence for more than 8 consecutive weeks.
The ration card holder must draw public distribution commodities from the fair price shop at least once every 8 weeks.
The ration card holder must produce the ration card on demand by an inspecting officer.
common_failure_reasons: Attempting to obtain a card through impersonation or fraudulent means
Absence from residence for more than 8 consecutive weeks
Failure to draw commodities from the fair price shop for a period exceeding 8 weeks
Failure to produce the ration card upon demand by an inspecting officer
case_brief.official_grievance_channel: State-specific Food and Civil Supplies Department portals (e.g., https://food.wb.gov.in/ for West Bengal; https://grievances.maharashtra.gov.in/ for Maharashtra)
documents_needed: Form F (Schedule F) for replacement of mutilated, defaced, or lost card
Form V-U (Schedule G2) for correction of name or address
Form VI-U (Schedule G3) for change of Fair Price Shop
